name: Amy African Hair Braiding And Boutique
_established_note: From the salon sign (EST 2010). Leave empty to hide.
_phone_secondary_note: Second salon number, confirmed by Amy (on her business card). Leave empty to hide it everywhere.

_whatsapp_note: Digits only, e.g. 13142491615. Leave empty unless Amy uses WhatsApp for business.
_google_reviews_note: Replace with the exact Google review link from Amy's Business Profile (Share > Ask for reviews) once available.
_hours_note: Fill only with hours Amy confirms, e.g. [["Mon–Fri", "9:00 AM – 7:00 PM"], ["Sat", "8:00 AM – 6:00 PM"]]. Empty shows 'Call to confirm hours'. Do not use Google's 24-hour listing.

google_rating._note: If show is true, the real rating is displayed exactly as it is on Google, with the date.

about._note: Fill any of these in Amy's own words; empty fields are hidden. story can be a list of paragraphs.
